description: Report a wrong, doubtful or missing figure, or something the tools can't do, to the Levels.fyi team. Offer it when the user doubts a figure or a tool finds nothing they asked about. Send it after the user agrees, or when they asked for the report. No personal details; contactEmail only when the user wants a reply and gives it. Returns { received, id }. REQUIRED arguments: kind, message.

companySlug.description: The company the report is about, as a slug.

contactEmail.description: Only when the user wants a reply and gives this address.

jobFamilySlug.description: The job family the report is about, as a slug.

kind.description: What the report is about: wrong_data (a figure looks wrong or out of date), missing_data (no data for a company, role, level or location), missing_feature (something the tools cannot do) or other.

locationSlug.description: The location the report is about, as a slug.

message.description: What is wrong or missing, in the user’s words. No personal details.

toolName.description: The tool whose result the report is about.

name: send-feedback
